_comment: Corpus-independent regression cases for sanskrit-search (exported from the adhyayana-sahakārī source; the corpus hit-count cases are not included).

sandhiJoin.note: aḥ+ā → hiatus (yatva+lopa 8.3.17/8.3.19), NOT savarna-dīrgha — रामालयः itself is a samāsa (bare stem rāma + ālayaḥ, no visarga involved), a different derivation entirely
samāsa-internal vowel sandhi (no visarga): bare stem rāma + ālayaḥ, plain a+ā→ā via vowelSandhi
B4: ḥ before ś RETAINED (do not assimilate)

8.4.45 यरोऽनुनासिके ऽनुनासिको वा: त्/द्+nasal → न् (dental class's OWN nasal, NOT a copy of the following one — real bug found 2026-08-06, Harsha: sandhiJoin previously gave तम्मयः, doubling म् instead of using त्'s own class nasal न्)
8.4.45, same fix — real corpus example (Ka Up.)
8.4.45, same fix — real corpus example (Ka Up.)
8.4.45, same fix — real corpus example (Ka Up.)
8.4.45, same fix — real corpus example (Ka Up.)
8.4.45, same fix — real corpus example (Ka Up.)
8.4.45, त्/द्+न् — coincidentally already correct before the fix (न् IS the dental class's own nasal), kept as a no-regression guard
म्+cons → ṃ (8.3.23 मोऽनुस्वारः; BG 2.11 त्वं प्रज्ञावादान्)
म्+cons → ṃ, unconditional before any consonant
r-derived visarga (punar) + voiced cons → r, NOT o (corpus regression, distinct from rāmaḥ+gacchati→rāmo-)
r-derived visarga + vowel → r (punar api), not punaḥ+a→o' hiatus
r-derived visarga + voiceless cons → retained ः, same as general rule
aiḥ + vowel → r, r fuses as mātrā (folio 817 regression)
āvādi: ai + vowel → āy (semivowel default): कस्यै एषः → कस्यायेषः
8.3.32 न् after short vowel doubles before vowel (folio 899 regression)
long ā-final न् does NOT double
guṇa ā+ṛ → ar (अर् cluster, not a mātrā)
guṇa a+ṛ → ar (fixes former R→ा bug)
word-final bare स् rutva's to विसर्ग then hiatus (Zenodo-corpus reconciliation, 2026-07-25): स्+V(non-a) → same as मनः+आदीनि
word-final bare स् → विसर्ग then aḥ+a→o' (no literal avagraha inserted, matching the existing सः+अयम्→सोयम् convention)
bare-र् rAvyaya spelling (पुनर् not पुनः) → same र्-derived visarga treatment as पुनः+तत्
regression guard: बरे र् NOT in the rAvyaya list keeps its र् before a vowel (day/अहन्-अहर्) — must NOT redirect to विसर्ग (a blanket-र् rule was tried and rejected: 50-case regression)
चर्त्व (8.4.55): remaining voiceless stops (क/ख/प/फ) devoice त्/द् → त्, beyond the already-covered श्चुत्व/ष्टुत्व/ल/ह/न-म/jaśtva pairs
8.4.55 खरि च: द् → त् before स (round 12)
8.4.55 त्; no ष्टुत्व before ष (8.4.43 तोः षि)
8.4.55: ड् → ट् (ट-वर्ग's चर्); no ष्टुत्व from a पदान्त ट-वर्ग (8.4.42)
NOT 8.4.55: ग is not खर् (द् stays, 8.4.53 domain)
6.1.73 छे च: short vowel (inherent अ) + छ → तुक् च् (BS 1.2.17 «न च्छायात्मादिरितर»)
6.1.76 पदान्ताद्वा: after a LONG पद-final vowel optional — primary keeps छ, च्छ is a sandhiJoinVariants form

toDeva.note: IAST: k+ṣ conjunct via halant, no special-case key needed
overlap subset (short vowels + plain consonants) with no diacritic → ITRANS path, byte-identical either way
ITRANS regression: unaffected by IAST addition
standard ITRANS: ch=च (चतुः) — purist ITRANS fix #1
ISO 15919 ring-below vocalic r (U+0325) → IAST ṛ → वृ; Windows/IAST vṛ→व्र fix #2

unitMatch.note: synthetic, corpus-independent lock on the coMatch fix: प्रत्यक् is compound-medial (महत्-प्रत्यक्-आत्मभूतम्) and sandhi-voiced (jaśtva क्→ग्) — needs both the wide-tier variant AND the dropped boundary check
guard: dropping the boundary requirement must not make coMatch match on ANYTHING — a genuinely absent second term (अग्नि) must still fail
word-final न् doubled before a vowel → anusvāra in text; a bare query must still find its own word
guard: short word gets NO anusvāra form (would flood); सं must not match संनेव
last word अर्थान् न् → anusvāra before a consonant across a space (व्यदधात्); multi-word right-edge nasal (Īśā Up. 8)
precise: leading अ absorbed (एव+अर्थ→एवार्थ) + short-अ ≥5 gate → correctly NO exact match (ार्थ floods ~21% of corpus)
high-recall fallback: gate dropped → finds the sandhi-fused अर्थम् (एवार्थमु)
precise: leading अ elided by pūrvarūpa (गुणे+अस्त्रि→गुणेऽस्त्रि, avagraha dropped) → no exact; elided form is wide-only
high-recall: े/ो-anchored elided form finds गुणेऽस्त्रियाम् (avagraha/pūrvarūpa)
anchored elided form must NOT match standalone स्त्री (not preceded by e/o) — अस्त्री ≠ स्त्री; precision guard for the antonym trap

exact-match is a plain literal substring find (like the browser's own Find) — no word-boundary restriction, so ब्रह्म embedded as the first member of the compound ब्रह्मविद्यां still matches; समास is unmarked by spaces in Devanāgarī, so whole-word anchoring would hide real matches

leading अ of अकायम् is silently ABSORBED into the preceding word's bare म् (शुक्रम्+अकायम्→शुक्रमकायम्, no visible trace at all — different from mlsA's vowel-merge and mlsE's े/ो-elision); mlsBare, glued to a preceding CONSONANT specifically (Īśā Up. 8)

regression guard: मlsBare requires the preceding character be a plain CONSONANT (isCons) — काय here is a standalone, space-preceded word (nothing was absorbed), not glued onto anything, so it must NOT match
ścutva श→छ: preceding paryagāt's त्+श→च्छ, so shukram is written च्छुक्रम् — left-edge consonant mutation (Īśā Up. 8)
tier: sh→chh is a speculative neighbor-fusion candidate → wide/dashed only, absent from precise/solid
guṇa a+u→o: preceding paramātma fuses upādhi's u into o (…mopādhi) — left-edge vowel mutation (BU 2.4.10)
tier: mlsG guṇa/vṛddhi lead is wide/dashed only
right-edge stop→nasal: vāk+maya→vāṅmaya (क्→ṅ), matched via body+anusvāra वां
tier: new right-edge consonant candidates are wide/dashed only
single-word right-edge savarṇa-dīrgha: gacchati + following iti → gacchatīti (i+i→ī); ≥5 stem gate
tier: single-word right-edge is wide/dashed only

single-word right-edge is UNGATED (never-suppress): even the 2-char pronoun tat surfaces its jaśtva form तद, so tat matches तदेव in the wide/dashed tier. It floods (~60% of corpus) — accepted; the user refines. Precise/solid is unaffected.
guard: lastCore strips only ā (not ī), so shrI cores to श्री (not श्र) → joinedCore तच्छ्री, which does NOT prefix-match तच्छ्रोत्रेण (शrotra ≠ śrī). Kills the short-onset over-match (Aitareya 1.3.6)
recall preserved: a genuine tat+shrI → तच्छ्री surface still matches (only the spurious śrotra prefix was removed)
single-word right-edge a/ā-guṇa (vidyA + following udeti → vidyodeti, ā+u→o) via lastCore's ā-strip wired into swRight (approach B)
tier: single-word right-edge is wide/dashed only
single-word right-edge yaṇ (jAnAmi + following atra → jAnāmyatra, i→y) via lastYan in swRight; candidate normalized so म्य folds to match
mls (ेव, the query's vowel as a mātrā on a preceding consonant) coincides with देव in वामदेव — a neighbor-fusion possibility, surfaced in the wide/dashed tier
tier: mls/mlsA/mlsBare DEMOTED to dashed (wide-only) — a coincidental left-edge fusion like ेव must NOT be a SOLID hit (governing principle: neighbor-fusion → dashed)
the actual word एवम् still matches in precise/SOLID via its stem (एव), unaffected by the mls demotion — only coincidental fusions moved to dashed
single-word stop→nasal right-edge: vāk+maya→vāṅmaya (क्→ṅ), via lastStopNasal (वां) now included in swRight; ≥3-stem gate admits vāk (Chāndogya 1.1.6)
tier: single-word right-edge is wide/dashed only
fix #3: single-word shukram — sh→chh left-edge PLUS the bare-म variant (च्छुक्रम, म before an out-of-query vowel) — now finds Īśā 1.8, parity with the 2-word 'shukram akAyam'
tier: left-edge fusion is wide/dashed only

lastTbody/lastTvars only checked word-final त्, missing द् — sandhiJoin treats them identically for ścutva/ṣṭutva/latva (उपनिषद्+शब्द→उपनिषच्छब्द, त्/द्+श→च्छ), so a द्-final query like upaniShad never got its wide-tier candidates at all (found via real Ka Up. bhāṣya search, 2026-07-25)
tier: single-word right-edge is wide/dashed only

the file-level JAS candidate map (feeding lastJas/swRight) only had the 5 UNASPIRATED voiceless stops (क/च/ट/त/प), missing their aspirated counterparts (ख/छ/ठ/थ/फ) that sandhiJoin's own inline jas map already handled — a थ्-final query like sanAth never got its voiced (सनाद) right-edge candidate at all (found while auditing the upaniShad/upaniShat bug for the same class of gap, 2026-07-25)
tier: single-word right-edge is wide/dashed only
v1.3.2 LEFT×RIGHT: guṇa left-edge (उ→ो, parama+upAdhi) crossed with yaṇ on upAdhi's OWN tail (i→y) — paramopādhyasti
tier: LEFT×RIGHT composition is wide/dashed only
v1.3.2 LEFT×RIGHT: guṇa left-edge crossed with savarṇa-dīrgha on the tail (i+i→ī) — paramopādhīti
tier: LEFT×RIGHT composition is wide/dashed only
v1.3.2 LEFT×RIGHT: guṇa left-edge (उ→ो, parama+udyat) crossed with jaśtva on the tail (त्→द्) — paramodyadapi
tier: LEFT×RIGHT composition is wide/dashed only
v1.3.2 LEFT×RIGHT: sh→chh left-edge (tat+sharman) crossed with न्-doubling→anusvāra on the tail (nasalAnusvara) — tacCharmanniti
tier: LEFT×RIGHT composition is wide/dashed only
v1.3.2 LEFT×RIGHT: sh→chh left-edge (tat+shishuH) crossed with the a-class core strip on the tail (visarga-stripped stem is a clean prefix of the र-outcome) — tacChishuriti
tier: LEFT×RIGHT composition is wide/dashed only
v1.3.2 LEFT×RIGHT: mlsBare (etad+adri, अ absorbed with no trace) crossed with savarṇa-dīrgha on adri's OWN tail (i+i→ī) — etadadrIva
tier: LEFT×RIGHT composition is wide/dashed only
v1.3.2 LEFT×RIGHT: mlsA (paramA+adri, अ+आ→आ savarṇa) crossed with savarṇa-dīrgha on adri's OWN tail (i+i→ī) — paramAdrIva
tier: LEFT×RIGHT composition is wide/dashed only
v1.3.2 LEFT×RIGHT: mls (vAk+indu, इ absorbed as a mātrā after jaśtva क्→ग्) crossed with savarṇa-dīrgha on indu's OWN tail (u+u→ū) — vAgindUdeti
tier: LEFT×RIGHT composition is wide/dashed only

unitMatch.note: tier: absorbed/elided-अ phrase forms stay OUT of the precise tier — dropping the अ erases the negation prefix (अविज्ञात इति → मन्ताऽविज्ञातो विज्ञातेति), ~40% wrong in a 200-phrase sample
e/o + अ elision (तेऽन्या) for a multi-word phrase, wide tier
glued gate: a bare न्या… after a SPACE is not an absorbed अ
8.4.55: तद् साधारणम् → तत्साधारणम्
no false hit
6.1.73: न छायात्मा → नच्छायात्मा (print spaced before च्छ)
6.1.76: the form without तुक् after a long vowel still matches

unitSpans.note: stem strips trailing ्; highlight must extend to cover it
anusvāra form maps back to कुर्वन् incl. its virāma
cross-space anusvāra match must not leave a trailing space in the highlight
leading-अ-elided form is े/ो-ANCHORED (won't false-match standalone स्त्री); highlight includes anchor े, avagraha, and the word-final म्
word-final म् (folds to anusvāra, stripped by the stem) must be pulled back into the highlight
live extension highlighting must also find the compound-embedded occurrence, matching matches()/exact-match-embedded-hit

last query word akAyam (ends म्/ं) followed by out-of-query vowel-initial avraNam: म्+V→bare म+mātra(V), not anusvāra — must reach the full word's own म, not fall back to the bare stem अकाय (Īśā Up. 8)

query's leading vowel इ is written as the mātrā ि fused onto the PRECEDING out-of-query word's final म् (tam+itthaMbhUtam); highlight must extend start back onto that म so it doesn't begin on a dangling combining mark
regression guard: extendStart must NOT touch the deliberate े/ो anchor of the leading-अ-elided (mlsE) field — only matraLead-style (mls/mlsA) dangling mātrās get pulled back
sh→chh left-edge: extension highlights the च्छ-form fused surface (Īśā Up. 8)
guṇa lead: mātrā-initial (ो sits on the preceding word), noStart-anchored like mlsE (BU 2.4.10)
right-edge stop→nasal highlight (vāṅ from vāk)
single-word a/ā-guṇa right-edge highlight (approach B)
single-word yaṇ right-edge highlight
single-word stop→nasal right-edge highlight (vāṅ from vāk)
single-word shukram bare-म left-edge highlight (fix #3)
v1.3.2 LEFT×RIGHT: guṇa lead × yaṇ tail highlight
v1.3.2 LEFT×RIGHT: guṇa lead × savarṇa-dīrgha tail highlight
v1.3.2 LEFT×RIGHT: guṇa lead × jaśtva tail highlight
v1.3.2 LEFT×RIGHT: sh→chh lead × न्-doubling tail highlight (maps back through normalize()'s anusvāra collapse to the real doubled-न् surface)
v1.3.2 LEFT×RIGHT: sh→chh lead × a-class core-strip tail highlight
v1.3.2 LEFT×RIGHT: mlsBare × savarṇa-dīrgha tail highlight (glued-gated, like mlsBare itself)
v1.3.2 LEFT×RIGHT: mlsA × savarṇa-dīrgha tail highlight
v1.3.2 LEFT×RIGHT: mls × savarṇa-dīrgha tail highlight

unitSnippet.note: search.html's snippet() path (snippetAny) must pick the LONGEST matching candidate in ex.combos, not just the first one found in array order — a shorter stem-based candidate (…अकाय) appears earlier than the fixed full-word one (…अकायम्), so a first-match-wins bug here reintroduced the same missing-म bug that findSpans() already fixed (Īśā Up. 8)
search.html path (snippetAny) highlights the sh→chh fused surface
search.html path highlights the guṇa lead
search.html path (snippetAny) highlights the v1.3.2 LEFT×RIGHT sh→chh × न्-doubling composition
search.html path highlights the v1.3.2 mlsBare × savarṇa-dīrgha composition (glued-gated)
search.html path highlights the v1.3.2 mls × savarṇa-dīrgha composition

found 2026-07-29 (Ka Up. intro bhāṣya, Harsha): उपनिषदम्+अधीमहे → उपनिषदमधीमहे (lastMBare — the म् loses its halant with no visible trace, absorbed into अधीमहे's own अ). Stem-match ('उपनिषद') stopped one character short of the म् the user actually searched for. Fixed via a new expectedNasal param threaded snippet→snippetAny→wrap→extendEnd: only extend past a bare nasal when the QUERY's own last word is known (via its normalized trailing ं) to end in म्, so unrelated bare nasals are never swallowed
guard: a query WITHOUT the final म् must NOT extend into the following bare म — the expectedNasal gate is query-specific, not a blanket bare-nasal grab
